title: Research Tree
description: A Research Tree mod for all of your needs. Supports many things and is fully data-driven!
body:
Ever needed a mod to help stop people from speedrunning the game from nothing to space in half an hour? Well, now you can make that process much longer! (With a side of "Oh come on :("!)

Research Tree allows mods and modpacks to create entire trees to make the game more fun!

Press **[G]** to open up the GUI

### How do I use this mod?
Visit the wiki (either in the sidebar or [this link](https://github.com/wolfieboy09/ResearchTree/wiki/), ask questions [here](https://github.com/wolfieboy09/ResearchTree), or visit the Discord for forms of previous questions. You know the drill.

# Notice
**This mod is still in its early stages of development!**
